steps.title: Point the switch at RADIUS
steps.body: Type `enable`, then `more flash:radius.txt`. In `conf t`: `aaa new-model`, then `radius server GRID-RAD` with `address ipv4 192.168.100.20 auth-port 1812 acct-port 1813` and `key <key>`, `exit`. Then `aaa authentication dot1x default group radius`, `aaa authorization network default group radius`, and `dot1x system-auth-control`.

objectives.label: RADIUS server address and ports set

steps.title: Guard a hangar port
steps.body: `interface g0/5`, `switchport mode access`, `authentication port-control auto`, `dot1x pae authenticator`. Do the same on `g0/6`, where an unknown laptop is plugged in. `end`, then `show authentication sessions`.

objectives.label: Saw crew07 authorized into VLAN 10, and Doom's laptop rejected

steps.title: Fix the Wi-Fi
steps.body: Read `more flash:wifi-audit.txt`. Which security mode should CREW-WIFI use? `submit MODE=...`. Which EAP method, with certificates on both sides? `submit EAP=...`.
